name: Kiyoura Mai
source:
Setsuna's mother. Mai is a successful career woman with experience in planning projects. She has a friendly rivalry with Saionji Yoko, mother of Sekai, and is always looking out to be helpful to Sekai any way she can.

[From the [url=https://shinydays.us/]offical website[/url]]
